description: Flat metadata schema for individual single-cell amplified genome records derived from uncultured marine microbes isolated by microfluidics and processed by lysis, whole-genome amplification, assembly, and annotation.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual SAG record or cell. Example: SAG_0001.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or isolate label for the single cell or SAG. Example: Station3_CellA.

marine_site_name.descr: Name of the marine sampling site, station, or cruise location.

marine_latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees. Use negative values for southern hemisphere.

marine_longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees. Use negative values for western hemisphere.

sample_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters (m) from which the target cell or environmental sample was obtained.

water_mass_or_habitat.descr: Marine habitat or water mass description. Example values: surface ocean, mesopelagic, coastal seawater, deep chlorophyll maximum.

collection_date.descr: Date when the original environmental sample was collected, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

cell_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the individual cell. Example values: microfluidics, flow cytometry, micromanipulation.

microfluidic_platform.descr: Specific microfluidic device or platform used for cell isolation, if applicable.

cell_sorting_or_capture_instrument.descr: Instrument or system used to capture or sort the cell, if relevant.

single_cell_input_volume_ul.descr: Volume of cell suspension or input material used for single-cell capture, in microliters (uL).

cell_enrichment_method.descr: Any pre-enrichment step used before single-cell isolation. Example values: filtration, FACS, dilution-to-extinction.

cell_viability_assessed.descr: Indicates whether cell viability was assessed before or after isolation.

lysis_method.descr: Method used to lyse the isolated cell. Example values: alkaline lysis, heat lysis, enzymatic lysis, detergent lysis.

lysis_buffer_composition.descr: Text description of the lysis buffer or reagents used, including key components and concentrations when known.

lysis_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used during lysis in degrees Celsius (C).

whole_genome_amplification_method.descr: Genome amplification method used after lysis. For SAGs this is commonly multiple displacement amplification (MDA).

amplification_enzyme.descr: Polymerase or amplification enzyme used. Example: phi29 DNA polymerase.

amplification_primers.descr: Primer type or sequence description used for whole-genome amplification.

amplification_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Reaction volume for whole-genome amplification, in microliters (uL).

amplification_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature for amplification in degrees Celsius (C).

amplification_time_hr.descr: Total amplification incubation time in hours.

amplification_cycles.descr: Number of thermal cycles if a cycling-based amplification strategy was used; otherwise use 1 for isothermal workflows when appropriate.

amplification_replicates.descr: Number of independent amplification reactions performed for this SAG.

negative_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a negative control was included during lysis or amplification.

positive_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a positive control was included during lysis or amplification.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol used before sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used. Example values: Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs (bp) for the sequencing data used to assemble the SAG.

paired_end_reads.descr: Indicates whether sequencing was performed in paired-end mode.

raw_read_count.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads generated for this SAG.

raw_bases_bp.descr: Total number of raw bases generated for this SAG, in base pairs (bp).

read_quality_filtering_method.descr: Method or software used for read trimming and quality filtering.

assembly_software.descr: Primary software used to assemble the SAG genome.

assembly_software_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_strategy.descr: Assembly strategy used. Example values: single-cell assembly, co-assembly, hybrid assembly.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key non-default assembly parameters or command-line settings used.

contig_count.descr: Total number of contigs in the final assembly.

assembly_size_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs (bp).

longest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the longest contig in base pairs (bp).

n50_bp.descr: N50 contig length in base pairs (bp).

l50_contigs.descr: L50 statistic: minimum number of contigs whose combined length makes up at least 50% of the assembly.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled SAG genome as a percentage from 0 to 100.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as a percentage from 0 to 100, typically from tools such as CheckM, GUNC, or related methods.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated contamination level as a percentage from 0 to 100.

chimera_detected.descr: Indicates whether chimeric sequences were detected in the assembly.

binning_or_curation_method.descr: Method used to curate, filter, or bin the SAG assembly after initial assembly.

annotation_software_version.descr: Version of the annotation software used.

predicted_gene_count.descr: Number of predicted protein-coding genes in the SAG assembly.

predicted_rrna_count.descr: Number of predicted rRNA genes in the SAG assembly.

predicted_trna_count.descr: Number of predicted tRNA genes in the SAG assembly.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Primary database or reference collection used for functional annotation. Example values: KEGG, Pfam, eggNOG, TIGRFAM.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Taxonomic classification assigned to the SAG, if available. Example: Proteobacteria; SAR11 clade.

ecological_role_inference.descr: Brief description of inferred ecological role or metabolic niche based on the genome. Example: heterotrophic carbon utilization, sulfur oxidation.

data_repository_accession.descr: Accession number or identifier for the assembled SAG in a repository or archive. Example: GenBank, ENA, IMG, MG-RAST accession.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Accession number for raw sequencing reads deposited in a public repository.

analysis_date.descr: Date when assembly/annotation analysis for this SAG was completed, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

quality_flag.descr: Overall quality classification for the SAG record. Example values: high_quality, medium_quality, low_quality.
